Q1: Which branch should the fix go on, given that the three new files exist only on PR #7026's head branch `claude/upbeat-johnson-gffyul-infra`?
Choices:
A) Target PR #7026's head branch `claude/upbeat-johnson-gffyul-infra`. Add a `Target branch: claude/upbeat-johnson-gffyul-infra` line to the issue body so plan and implement check out that branch. The fix PR then stacks on #7026 and only edits `docs/INVENTORY.md` and the generated workflow list in `agents.md`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Target the default branch (`main`) and add the entries there before #7026 merges. **Note:** the parity check would then fail on `main`, because the listed files don't exist there until #7026 merges.
C) Fix nothing in the pipeline: close this issue and leave the inventory/`agents.md` update to whoever is working on PR #7026, since it's a `claude/*` branch from an interactive session.
